meta.notes: X is mid-migration between two front ends. The rebuilt one (served to logged-out visitors on 2026-11-07, signed-in users move gradually) has NO data-testid attributes; it uses data-interaction, data-slot, href and role. The classic React app keeps data-testid. Selectors for both families sit in one option; the family that is absent matches nothing. LIVE on the rebuilt front end (logged out): app-obstruction matched 1 (dialog, backdrop and close button; no scroll lock), open-app-pill matched 2 (a[href*=launch_app_store] matches 50: every tab, like and status link, so it must stay narrow). Never hide a[data-interaction=mobile-top-bar-log-in]. SOURCE only (classic app, logged in): FreekyCreep x.com list 2026-09-27, AdGuard X filter 2025.1229, char gist 2025-02: every premium-*, promoted-*, grok-* rule. explore-link (AppTabBar_Explore_Link) is from memory, not a list. No selector exists for For you vs Following, Discover more, Today's News or Who to follow without text matching. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA): x.com serves the rebuilt front end logged out, without data-testid, so the classic-app selectors in the desktop rules are INFERRED (hand-written fixture desktop-timeline.html): premium-card, right-column-desktop, trends-section, who-to-follow-card, counts-reply-repost, counts-like-views, dm-drawer, nav-jobs-lists, verified-ticks.
